content.title: Common Questions
content.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you visit.

items.question: Do you offer Wi-Fi for guests?
items.answer: Yes, we provide fast, complimentary Wi-Fi for all our guests. We have plenty of outlets available near our wall-facing seats for those looking to work or study.

items.question: Where do you source your coffee beans?
items.answer: We partner with local Bay Area roasters who prioritize direct-trade relationships, paying premium wages to farmers, and encouraging sustainable farming practices.

items.question: Do you have vegan or gluten-free pastry options?
items.answer: Absolutely. We stock a rotating selection of vegan and gluten-free treats from local specialty bakers every morning to ensure there is something for everyone.

items.question: Can I reserve a table for a meeting?
items.answer: We operate on a first-come, first-served basis. However, our spacious communal table is often available for small groups during early weekday mornings.

content.title: Start Your Morning with Juniper
content.body: Skip the line by ordering ahead, or simply drop in to find your favorite spot by the window. We can't wait to pour your next cup.
